_about: Pre-season sizes (PreSeason.gd). One line of explanation per tunable in _why.

_why.weeks: Length of the pre-season. Week 8 is the quiet week of the papers, with no action.
_why.train_weeks: The training weeks, each one action: Running, Game plan drilling or Team bonding (director 2026-11-17).
_why.plan_run_weeks: The weeks of running each season fitness plan needs (director 2026-11-17: Peak 5, Fast 4, Steady 3, Develop 2). Once the weeks left are only enough for it, Running is the one action open; no extra running past it.
_why.trial_best: How many names the time trial gives from the front.
_why.trial_worst: How many names it gives from the back.
_why.trial_noise: Spread of the day's form in the time trial, in durability points.
_why.seen_uncertainty: How wide a club's rating read on a prospect is once it has trialled him in its pre-season match, as a share of its usual read (1.0 is no tighter; the recruiting department's own tightening still applies on top).
_why.guest_spare_number: Trialled prospects wear spare jumper numbers from this one up, skipping any a listed player wears.
_why.practice_week: The one pre-season match, against another club, is played at the end of this week (director, 2026-11-03: the intra-club match and the practice match are one).
_why.practice_guests: Prospects a club trials in it, each in place of the weakest starter in his line. A spot the coach leaves empty is filled by his recruiters.
_why.practice_injury_rate: A listed player's injury risk in the practice match, as a share of a normal match's (director, 2026-10-14: half).
_why.practice_xp_games: Development for a listed player who plays in it, in reserves games' worth.
_why.familiar_default: Where a plan starts for a club that has never drilled it, when it is not the club's usual plan: 0 barely, 1 partly, 2 well. The usual plan and Balanced start well.
_why.familiar_mult: How much of a plan's upside a side keeps at each level of knowing it (1.0 is today's game). What a plan gives up does not change. The director's call: small to start.
_why.drill_step_weeks: Weeks of drilling one plan needs to move up a step. A week split between the position groups counts each group's plan by its share of the list.
_why.drill_max_plans: The plans one drilling week drills (director 2026-11-17: one plan per week, or one per position group).
_why.fade_rounds: Rounds a plan can go unplayed before the side knows it a step less (slowly; the off-season slip is a step on every plan).
_why.papers_claim_up: Places above the paper's ladder the coach names when he talks the club up (never above first). The board's goal does not move.
_why.papers_breakout_age: The papers tip a breakout among players of this age or younger.
_why.papers_short_wins_pos: For a club whose goal is 'win seven games', the papers are taken to doubt it when they have it finishing below this place.
_why.papers_after: Weeks into the season before a talked-up finish can be held against the club.
_why.papers_within: Weeks after that the papers can still come back for it.
_why.papers_places: How many places below its own words the club must sit for the papers to come back.
